meta.name: hunt-fintech-graphql
meta.description: Hunt fintech-specific GraphQL vulnerabilities: money-movement mutations (transfers, redemptions, withdrawals, card top-ups), ledger/balance/portfolio query IDOR, decimal-precision and rounding abuse, idempotency-key bypass enabling double-spend, KYC/PII field-level authorization gaps, and admin-override mutations reachable via mass assignment. Distinct from hunt-graphql, which owns generic GraphQL discovery and IDOR/mutation methodology — this skill owns the delta introduced when a GraphQL layer sits in front of a ledger, wallet, payments, banking, brokerage, or lending backend, where a resolver bug moves real money instead of just leaking data. Use when hunting a fintech, banking, payments, wallet, neobank, brokerage, or lending target that exposes a GraphQL API, or when a schema/response includes balance, transfer, ledger, redeem, quote, KYC, or account-linking fields.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现金融应用中资金操作与账户信息的安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在测试金融系统接口，担心转账、提现等环节有安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Find security flaws in fintech apps' money-moving operations and account data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you test financial APIs and worry about vulnerabilities in transfers and account data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会针对金融类 GraphQL 接口执行安全测试：检查转账、提现等资金操作是否可被篡改或重放，验证余额查询是否泄露他人数据，测试金额精度、幂等键、字段级权限校验等漏洞，并只报告有账本状态变化证据的发现。
howto.when: 当你对暴露 GraphQL 接口的金融类目标（银行、支付、钱包等）做安全测试，或接口数据里含有余额、转账、账本等字段时触发。

say.text: 检查这个 GraphQL 接口的转账 mutation 是否存在幂等键绕过漏洞
say.note: Claude 会重发相同幂等键，观察是否产生第二笔账

say.text: 用他人的账户 ID 查询余额，测试是否越权返回数据
say.note: Claude 会构造跨账户查询，验证是否泄露他人数据

say.text: 用 0.001 和科学计数法金额测试 transferFunds 的精度处理
say.note: Claude 会发送异常金额值，检查服务端舍入逻辑

howto.what_en: Audits fintech GraphQL APIs for money-mutation flaws, balance IDOR, decimal abuse, idempotency-key double-spends, KYC/PII auth gaps, and mass-assignment admin mutations. Reports only proven ledger changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when hunting a fintech target (banking, payments, wallet, etc.) exposing a GraphQL API, or when the schema/response contains balance, transfer, ledger, or similar fields.

say_en.text: Check this GraphQL API's transfer mutation for idempotency-key bypass.
say_en.note: Claude replays the key, checking for a second ledger entry.

say_en.text: Fetch an account ID that isn't mine on the balance query to test IDOR.
say_en.note: Claude tests a cross-account query for data leaks.

say_en.text: Probe transferFunds amount handling with 0.001 and 1e2.
say_en.note: Claude sends edge-case amounts to expose rounding errors.
